text:
Maya (CS): FYI weekly Halo account pulse — focusing on token usage + throughput QoQ/WoW. Notable: WoW token spike + small latency tail increase.
Raul (CSM): saw that in dashboard earlier today, spike started Thu evening. linked the graphs in the report.
ingest-bot: summary uploaded: https://redwood.internal/reports/halo-weekly-2512349999.pdf
Maya (CS): Quick snapshot (WoW / QoQ):
```
- Tokens: +42% WoW, +18% QoQ
- Peak req/s: 1,200 -> 1,750 (avg sustained 900->1,100)
- 95p latency: 180ms -> 320ms (WoW)
- Error rate (5xx): 0.3% -> 0.9% (most transient timeouts)
- Spend: +36% WoW (model upsizing & burst)
```
Vijay (Support Eng): digging into infra logs — seeing some KV cache misses and higher batch time during spikes. I'll open a ticket with eng-runtime.
Raul (CSM): customer notes: rolling out a feature that increases prompt length/prefix caching. probably explains token jump. I asked for feature rollout ETA.
Maya (CS): Risk calc: renewal risk low today but cost spike + latency could hit SLOs for their enterprise contract. recommend enablement + config review this week.
Sophia (Sales): tagging in case we need to preempt renewal talk. Can we quantify likely monthly burn if trend continues?
Maya (CS): rough estimate = current weekly *4 => ~2.8x prior monthly baseline. I'll attach a calc after Vijay's infra notes.
Vijay (Support Eng): action items: 1) create ENG ticket for KV cache tuning + investigate batch sizing; 2) enable per-route caching for heavy prompts; 3) prod trace for 2025-03-13 22:00-23:30 (peak window). ETA EOD.
Raul (CSM): enablement ask: set up 30m call with Halo engineering to review prompt patterns + recommend quantization/profile options from Redwood Optimize. Who can join?
Maya (CS): I can run the call Wed 10am PT. Invite: @Sophia, @Vijay.
Sophia (Sales): on calendar. I'll surface potential cost relief options from commercial (discount for committed capacity / short-term burst).
Maya (CS): Quick mitigations we can propose now: lower max tokens on non-critical endpoints, enable prefix/KV caching, temporary rate cap on background jobs.
Raul (CSM): I'll draft a one-page note for customer with those mitigations + the graphs.
Vijay (Support Eng): opened ENG-5427 for runtime investigation. added logs + a couple sample request ids.
Maya (CS): OK — follow ups: R: Raul to send customer note by tomorrow noon; R: Vijay to post findings in ENG ticket; R: Maya to run enablement call Wed. If latency not resolved after infra tune, escalate to eng-runtime and consider model fallback policy. :thumbsup:
Raul (CSM): noted. sending note now.
Maya (CS): thanks team. I'll update renewal risk if anything changes before next check-in.
